text:
* COUNTING, DECLARED ONCE — ONE POPULATION (registry-v4 §2.5, PLR-COUNT's base). The state
 * line, the mark's accessible name, the rows and `and N more` all count the same people: everyone
 * at this board, you included. A page with no room is one person at this board, and the sheet
 * says so with your own row. The pass-4 `alone` / `others` pair counted OTHER players while the
 * rows counted everyone, three populations in one sheet; it is retired. The mark draws one stroke
 * per person and writes the number from six, so its name carries every digit the glyph paints
 * (WCAG 2.5.3 by construction): `6` is a substring of `6 players`.
